text: Bupa, originally the British United Provident Association, is a company limited by guarantee with no shareholders; it reinvests profits into providing healthcare rather than paying shareholders.

source.name: Bupa Group: 'Our story'
source.quote: they created Bupa as a company limited by guarantee. With no shareholders, we reinvest profits into providing more and better healthcare
source.note: The page carries no publication date; 2026 is the year the page was read. Bupa has been a Global Partner of New Zealand Rugby per allblacks.com/partners.
